summary: Renames the published image to debeski/dlux-crm:sales — one repository per product, with the tag naming the edition.
highlights: compose.yml, CI and the release workflow publish and pull debeski/dlux-crm:sales-<ver> + :sales.
Matches the gov edition's debeski/dlux-crm:gov; set WEB_IMAGE on every deployment host.
Every service carries an org.dlux.restart label, matching the dlux scaffold contract.
